info.title: API.SH: Decathlon
info.description: The Decathlon API from API.SH: public Decathlon data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A Decathlon category page (e.g. sports/camping/tents) by path or link, with the same product fields, filter groups (each with a `path` to apply it), sorts, breadcrumbs and paging as search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/decathlon-category

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: A category path (sports/camping/tents), a filter option's `path` from an answer, or a Decathlon category link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Decathlon country site (a link sets it).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Decathlon product details, variants and online stock
get.description:
One Decathlon product by link: name, brand, rating and review count, catchline, description, what it is designed for, product nature, sports, genders, weight, advantages, technical information, characteristics, care instructions, images, every model (colour) with each size's SKU, price, price without tax, reference price and discount, price validity, condition, seller, fulfilment and delivery lead time, similar and cross-selling SKUs, the online stock (quantity) of the selected model's sizes and `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/decathlon-product

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Decathlon product link (the country comes from it), its path, or `<product id>/<model code>` with country. Links of the form `…/p/<name>/_/R-p-<product id>?mc=<model id>` (used by the Hungarian and Turkish sites) work too.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country site when url is not a full link.

parameters.name: stock
parameters.description: Include the online stock of the selected model's sizes.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Decathlon product reviews and rating breakdown
get.description:
Customer reviews of a Decathlon product model: rating, title, text, date, recommended, reviewer's display name, verified purchase flag, per-attribute ratings, and the model's stats (average, count, recommendation count, rating distribution, average per attribute, fit and width distribution). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/decathlon-reviews

parameters.name: model_id
parameters.description: The model id (the number after m in a product link: …/c98c241m8648383) or a result's `model_id`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Decathlon product link instead of model_id (its country is used).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Decathlon country site (reviews in that country's language).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Decathlon product search with filters (20 country sites)
get.description:
Search a Decathlon country site (UK, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal, Poland, Austria, Switzerland, Ireland, Czechia, Slovakia, Hungary, Turkey, Canada, Mexico, Chile, Colombia), with prices in the local currency. Each product: ids (product, model, SKU), name, brand, link, price with currency, price without tax, reference price and discount, rating and review count, product nature, sports, seller (Decathlon or marketplace seller), online availability, sizes, colours, badges, every model (colour) with its own price and link, image and `raw`. The answer lists every filter group (brand, seller, colour, gender, size, sport, product type and the product specifications) with counts and a `path` to pass back as `path` to apply it, the price range, the sorts, suggested categories and breadcrumbs. A barcode (EAN) or other query the site answers with a single product page returns that product as the one item (`product_page: true`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/decathlon-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keywords. Optional when path is given.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Decathlon country site (a link in path sets it). Canada is the English site; Canadian prices exclude sales tax, so `price_without_tax` is the shelf price.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: A listing path from a filter option's, sort's or category's `path` in an answer, or a Decathlon listing link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
